visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short black hair stands in a brightly lit indoor space with a white wall and a dark door in the background. She touches her face with both hands, expressing concern about her makeup. (2) Close-up views focus on the skin around her nose, highlighting texture and oiliness. She points with a white-nailed finger to indicate specific problem areas. (3) The woman introduces a solution, holding a glass bottle of YSL 'All Hours Foundation' toward the camera. She is now wearing a black leather jacket over a black top. (4) She applies the foundation to her face using a black teardrop-shaped makeup sponge, dabbing it evenly across her cheek and chin. (5) She looks into a small circular white mirror, examining her reflection while touching her eye area and smile lines. (6) She showcases a square, black quilted leather YSL powder compact with a silver logo. She opens it to display the black puff and the white powder inside. (7) She demonstrates the powder's effect by applying it to the back of her hand with the puff, showing a transition from shiny to matte skin. (8) She applies the powder to her face, focusing on her under-eyes, forehead, and the sides of her nose, using the folded puff for precision. (9) Four swatches of different powder shades are shown on her inner arm, labeled with numbers from 01 to 05. (10) She demonstrates a specific brightening powder on a darker patch of skin on her arm to show its corrective power. (11) A split-screen comparison shows two photos on a mobile phone: one taken at 14:54 (fresh makeup) and another at 22:03 (after 8 hours), showing the makeup's durability. (12) She smiles at the camera, showing her finished smooth makeup look. She then holds up a black YSL branded makeup bag to promote a special offer.

(3) She provides detailed instructions on application, maintaining a friendly and high-arousal tone. The music rhythm is steady. (4) As she showcases the powder compact, she uses emphasis in her delivery, accompanied by subtle digital SFX during product transitions. (5) The speaker explains color correction techniques with organized pacing. Her voice sounds energetic yet calm. (6) She concludes with an enthusiastic promotional announcement, her volume increasing slightly. The music track ends cleanly with her closing remark.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Problem -> Solution Intro -> Demonstration -> Evidence/Results -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a beauty tutorial and promotional advertisement for YSL beauty products, specifically foundation and setting powder. It aims to teach viewers how to achieve a long-lasting, matte makeup finish and invites them to purchase the products to receive a gift.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct presentation of YSL branded products, step-by-step tutorial using them, and a concluding call-to-action regarding a promotional offer.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A high-quality, professionally edited short-form video that effectively combines educational content with brand marketing.
